from_quote: The senators are to be chosen for the period of six years
rationale: States that senators are to be chosen for six years and, in the same sentence, that no State is to have more than two senators, the terms of this clause.
to_quote: two Senators from each State, chosen by the Legislature thereof, for six Years

from_quote: there is to be a rotation, by which the seats of a third part of them are to be vacated and replenished every two years
rationale: Describes the rotation of this clause, by which the seats of "a third part" of the senators are vacated "every two years," echoing "one third may be chosen every second Year."
to_quote: so that one third may be chosen every second Year

from_quote: with regard to the federal House of Representatives, there is intended to be a general election of members once in two years
rationale: States that the House of Representatives is to be elected "once in two years," the term set in this clause ("chosen every second Year").

from_quote: a quorum of the body is to consist of sixteen members
rationale: Gives a quorum of the Senate as "sixteen members" but does not quote or name a clause; the link rests only on this being the clause that sets the quorum of each House ("a Majority of each shall constitute a Quorum").
